input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives automatic one-year renewals (acceptable) but a 90-day non-renewal notice window, which exceeds the 60-day fallback ceiling and the 30-day preferred window, so it fails the fallback on a material term. The redline narrows only the Company's window to 30 days' written notice, retaining HDI's 90-day window so our own notice protection is not diluted, and adds the preferred 60-day HDI renewal reminder. Renewal is on the same terms with no price-escalation mechanic, so the CPI/3% cap condition is inapplicable and no uplift language is proposed.

ops.text: HDI shall notify the Company in writing of each upcoming automatic renewal not less than 60 days prior to the applicable anniversary of the Effective Date.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have cut our own non-renewal notice window from 90 days to 30 days' written notice (HDI's 90-day window is untouched) and added an HDI reminder 60 days before each automatic renewal, so the 12-month auto-renewal remains easy for us to exit.
proposal.summary: Cut the Company's non-renewal notice window to 30 days (HDI's 90-day window retained) and add a 60-day renewal reminder.
